title: vigna umbellata
intro: Vigna umbellata, commonly known as Indian lotus vine or Indian vetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include its health benefits such as reducing inflammation, aiding in digestion, and helping to lower blood sugar levels. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Vigna umbellata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
